TCD.note: Ethical and explainable AI is a mandate of the lab; no rule or authority on AI harms.
A research lab is described; no government AI system in use.
Sector fields are research areas; no sectoral AI tool stated.

facts.fact: Arrete 095/2026, signed 3 August 2026 by the higher education minister, creates the LIDIA AI research lab inside the CNRD to design and evaluate AI systems, with an annual CNRD budget line and open software and databases among its outputs.

systems.system: LIDIA (Laboratoire InterDisciplinaire de recherche en Intelligence Artificielle)
systems.owner: Centre National de Recherche pour le Developpement (CNRD)
